title: agentic-swe Organization resource (AE-036a / ADR-017)
description: First-class Organization / Team / Project / User / Role / Workspace records with explicit ownership. Schema + ownership validation; access checks are AE-036b.

type.description: ADR-017 A3 resource kinds. Unknown types fail closed.

tenant_id.description: Pilot tenant_id from human-written project config (ADR-017 C1). Not inferred from caller input.

owner.description: Explicit ownership. Owner must resolve in the known-owner catalog or validation fails closed.

kind.description: Owner resource kind. Role and workspace cannot own other resources.

parent_id.description: Optional parent resource id (team→org, project→team/org, workspace→project).

org_id.description: Organization binding when type is not organization.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative labels; never used for access elevation.
